note: Verified prior editions of recurring opportunities. This is what scripts/sonar_db.py forecast reads to predict when an undated event will next run - circular-mean day-of-year over past editions. Load with `python3 scripts/sonar_db.py seed-editions`.
rule: Every date here must trace to something already verified, not inferred. A fabricated prior date produces a confidently wrong watch window months from now, when nobody remembers where it came from - the worst failure this system can have, because it looks exactly like a real prediction.
forecasting_requirement: forecast_from_editions() needs at least 2 dated editions per opportunity_slug (one data point is an anecdote, not a season). Right now NO event has two. Everything below is a first data point. The second one has to be researched - see `needed` at the bottom for exactly which years to look for.
